data.title: SSRU Partners with IIFM Milano to Launch 'Experience the Italian Essence'
data.description: Suan Sunandha Rajabhat University (SSRU) Faculty of Fine and Applied Arts has advanced its international academic collaboration by partnering with the Italian Institute of Fashion Management (IIFM) in Milan, Italy, to launch “Experience the Italian Essence: Milan Edition 2026”, an international executive education programme designed to provide participants with first-hand exposure to Italy’s fashion, luxury and creative industries at their source.

data.title: Huawei Launches FusionSolar 9.0: First Grid-Forming PV Inverter for Thailand’s AI Era
data.description: Bangkok, 13 Aug 2026 — At the Huawei Digital Power Summit held under the theme “Energy, the Foundation of AI,” Huawei officially launched FusionSolar 9.0 — the world’s first Smart String Grid-Forming PV Inverter. The landmark event gathered over 700 policymakers, industry leaders, and energy experts to explore how next-generation grid-forming technologies can accelerate Thailand’s renewable energy transition while supporting the heavy power demands of AI data centres (AIDCs) and EV charging infrastructure.

data.title: “Routes to Roots” Wins Creative Data Award at CEA 2026
data.description: As Thailand's tourism landscape continues to evolve, data from the Ministry of Tourism and Sports showd that tourist numbers have declined by 3.05% from the same period last year. Thailand's challenge may therefore no longer be simply, "How can we attract more tourists to Thailand?" but rather, "How can every journey by both Thai and international travellers create greater value?" The goal is to drive equitable tourism by distributing economic opportunities to communities, creating local value more broadly and inclusively, and enabling sustainable growth.

data.title: THAI, VitalLife and Bumrungrad Partner on Wellness-Focused In-Flight Entertainment
data.description: Thai Airways International Public Co Ltd (THAI), VitalLife Scientific Wellness Center, and Bumrungrad International Hospital have signed a memorandum of understanding (MoU) to collaborate on the development of a new generation of in-flight entertainment (IFE) content that integrates travel, lifestyle and health knowledge. The initiative aims to enhance the onboard experience by inspiring passengers to embrace healthier lifestyles while showcasing Thailand’s unique destinations through a fresh wellness perspective.

data.description: As artificial intelligence (AI), datacentres, cloud computing, electricvehiclesand smart manufacturing continue to reshape the global economy, demand for advanced electronics, semiconductors and next-generation manufacturing technologies is growing at an unprecedented pace.

data.description: Bangkok has been chosen as the latest destination for Cova, the historic Italian café and pâtisserie acquired by LVMH, as the more than 200-year-old Milanese maison continues expanding its legacy of craftsmanship, hospitality and luxury.

data.title: ONE Championship: Kana wants Vero rematch, says ‘rounds one and three were mine’
data.description: Kana wants another shot at Vero Nika in ONE Championship after claiming she won two of the three rounds in their contentious atomweight kickboxing fight.

data.title: TIDLOR Delivers Strong H1/26 Net Profit Up 26.2%, Driven by Lending & Insurance Brokerage
data.description: Mrs. Athitaya Phoonwathu, Managing Director of Tidlor Holdings Public Company Limited, or Tidlor Holdings (“the Group”) (TIDLOR), revealed that in the second quarter of 2026, the Group continued to deliver strong growth despite the economic slowdown. The Group reported a net profit of 1,533.2 million baht, increasing 18.3% YoY. This resulted in a total net profit of 3,147.0 million baht for the first half of 2026, increasing 26.2% YoY, supported by revenue growth across both the lending and insurance brokerage businesses, coupled with effective cost and asset quality management.

data.title: NEO Wins Prime Minister’s Export Award 2026 for Best Exporter
data.description: Mr. Suthidej Thakolsri, Chief Executive Officer of NEO Corporate Public Company Limited, accepted the Prime Minister’s Export Award 2026 for Best Exporter from Mr. Anutin Charnvirakul, Prime Minister and Minister of Interior. The accolade celebrates NEO’s outstanding success as an innovative Asian FMCG leader committed to enhancing consumers' quality of life. Guided by its "Innovation from Core to Care" philosophy, NEO continues to develop high-quality, accessible Thai brands tailored for daily living, advance manufacturing standards to international levels, and drive sustainable growth across global markets. This recognition further reinforces NEO's strong corporate standing and demonstrates the capability of Thai business leaders to compete sustainably on the world stage. The award presentation was held on August 7, 2026, at the Santi Maitree Building, Government House.

data.title: CP Innovation Center of Excellence’s new platform cements global hub status
data.description: BANGKOK, August 13, 2026 — Charoen Pokphand Group (CP Group) has announced the launch of CP-CoEX (Center of Excellence x Exponential), signalling the next phase of its twofold strategy of developing people and creating innovation in response to the major technological changes impacting the world. CP-CoEX is a global learning and innovation platform that connects leaders and experts from tech businesses and universities around the world to address real challenges presently facing the industrial sector. The announcement further consolidates the status of the hosting CP Innovation Center of Excellence (CPIC) as a hub for innovation, learning and the acquisition of future skills.

data.title: Thailand to Host 29th ASEAN Labour Ministers’ Meeting
data.description: Thailand is set to host the 29th ASEAN Labour Ministers Meeting and Related Meetings (ALMM), reaffirming its commitment to advancing regional workforce development. Held under the theme, “Advancing ASEAN Human Capital: Skills Certification towards Global Recognition,” the Meeting will bring together the 11 ASEAN Member States to strengthen cooperation in enhancing the skills, mobility, and competitiveness of more than 357 million workers across the region.

data.title: Building Confidence with 'Dr. Phed' of Fiora Clinic
data.description: Bangkok, Thailand – As Thailand steps up to become the Medical and Wellness Hub of the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region, expats residing in this region, as well as high-end travelers, are increasingly seeking premium, safe, and highly personalized beauty services. Standing at the forefront of this rapidly growing industry is Dr. Chairat Sermsilp (Dr. Petch, Medical License: 45095), an expert aesthetic physician and executive of Fiora Clinic .

data.title: TrueVisions NOW Partners with Viu in Major Media Milestone
data.description: From stories created by Thai talent to new opportunities in the regional content market, TrueVisions NOW, Thailand’s leading streaming platform and entertainment content provider, has announced a strategic partnership with Viu, a leading regional OTT video streaming platform. Through this collaboration, the two companies are launching the “TrueVisions NOW Branded Zone,” an exclusive content hub on Viu showcasing quality original series from TrueVisions NOW. The partnership will initially bring six original series from a slate of 24 titles to Viu audiences in Malaysia, Indonesia, and the Philippines. This partnership marks another important milestone for TrueVisions NOW as it evolves from creating content for Thai audiences to expanding its regional reach and unlocking new opportunities for Thai IP in international markets. It also reinforces TrueVisions NOW’s commitment to bringing Thai creativity, distinctive cultural identity, and compelling storytelling to a broader audience across the region.

data.title: The Bangkok Post launches premium digital subscription to support next phase of digital growth
data.description: The Bangkok Post will introduce its premium digital subscription on Aug 14, 2026, signalling the next phase of its digital strategy as it scales reader revenue alongside print, Epaper and advertising operations.

data.title: IGNIV Circle debuts with an intimate champagne, caviar and cooking experience
data.description: Bangkok, Thailand – August 13, 2026 – IGNIV Bangkok (one MICHELIN Star) introduces IGNIV Circle, a new quarterly masterclass and lunch series with a MICHELIN-starred chef that brings guests closer to the people, philosophy, and techniques behind IGNIV's sharing concept. The inaugural edition, taking place on Sunday, August 23, 2026 , invites guests to an intimate afternoon of Champagne, caviar, and cooking led by IGNIV Bangkok Restaurant Manager & Sommelier Christian Hotz and Joël Ellenberger, Head Chef of the two MICHELIN-starred IGNIV Bad Ragaz in Switzerland, who is currently in residence at IGNIV Bangkok.

data.title: Sri Trang Rises to No. 105 on Fortune Southeast Asia 500, Tops Thai Rubber Sector
data.description: Sri Trang Agro-Industry Public Company Limited (STA) , The world’s largest fully integrated natural rubber enterprise and Thailand’s leading rubber glove manufacture, has once again been recognized as one of Southeast Asia’s largest companies in the 2026 Fortune Southeast Asia 500 , ranking No. 105, up five places from No. 110 last year. STA also secured the highest ranking among Thai rubber companies included in this year’s list, reinforcing its competitive strength and demonstrating the global competitiveness of Thailand’s natural rubber industry.

data.title: Thailand & Canada Pilot Carbon Capture in Cement Industry to Advance Net Zero 2050
data.description: Thai Cement Manufacturers Association (TCMA) is advancing Thailand–Canada collaboration by piloting carbon capture technology in the Thai cement industry. The initiative designates the “Saraburi Sandbox” as a low-carbon technology testbed, bringing together industry, government, academia, and global partners to support the transition to a low-carbon economy, while enhancing the long-term competitiveness of Thailand’s industrial sector.

data.title: Songsaeng Autotires marks nearly 60 years in Thailand, three generations strong
data.description: Songsaeng Autotires, a family-owned automotive service and tyre company in Thailand, has reaffirmed its commitment to quality service and customer trust as it marks nearly six decades in business, a legacy now carried by its third generation.

data.title: CP AXTRA posts H1 2026 revenue of B268.33bn, online sales up 29%
data.description: CP AXTRA Public Company Limited (The Company or CPAXT), the operator of “Makro and Lotus’s,” Store transformation lifts mall occupancy by 4% announced its operating results for the first half of 2026, with total revenue of 268,334 million baht, an increase of 3.6% year-on-year. Online sales via the Makro PRO platform and Lotus’s SMART App grew more than 29%, Store transformation lifts mall occupancy by 4% and out-of-store sales continued to expand, underscoring the strength of the Company’s omnichannel strategy. The Company also advanced its “Happy & Healthy Mall” strategy, raising mall occupancy rates, particularly at newly transformed locations. Together, these results mark a new milestone in enhancing customer experience by seamlessly connecting the three core pillars of the Company’s Retail Ecosystem: online channels, physical stores and shopping mall spaces.

data.title: MINT Posts 13% Profit Growth in 1H26, Demonstrating Global Resilience
data.description: Bangkok, Thailand – Minor International Public Company Limited (MINT) demonstrated the strength of its diversified, globally-balanced business model, delivering 13% year-on-year net profit growth to THB 3,957 million in 1H26, a result achieved despite a second quarter marked by heightened geopolitical tensions in the Middle East and softer regional travel sentiment. MINT’s broad geographic footprint and disciplined execution turned a challenging environment into another period ofearningsgrowth.
